requirements.rule: SIMPLIFICATION: Apprendistato livello V (Art. 30). Il livello V ha ordine 2 e il livello a ordine 0 non esiste; il primo semestre a 2 livelli sotto non e applicabile. SEMPLIFICAZIONE: primo semestre a 1 livello sotto (VI). L'apprendista percepisce piu del previsto contrattualmente nella prima meta. L'intera durata (36 mesi) e al livello VI.
requirements.remediation: Pay the first semester of the level V track at the contractual level once the classification allows it.

requirements.rule: SIMPLIFICATION: Apprendistato livello VI (Art. 30 + Art. 37). Art. 30 prevedeva il primo semestre al VII livello, che il rinnovo 2024 ha eliminato. SEMPLIFICAZIONE: l'intera durata apprendistato VI (24 mesi) e al livello di destinazione VI (levels_below=0). L'apprendista percepisce piu del previsto contrattualmente.
requirements.remediation: Confirm the level VI track after the 2024 renewal and model its first semester.

requirements.rule: Art. 83 pays 15% for weekly hours 41-48 and 20% beyond hour 48. Both bands are present; the engine resolves weekly tiers when the event supplies weekly_hours_before. Without that worker fact, the caller must supply the multiplier for each tier.
requirements.remediation: Supply OvertimeEvent.weekly_hours_before, or separate the hours and supply each tier's multiplier.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid none, its treatment not being sourced.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.
